issues.kind: rendered annotation targets and inactive-state semantics
issues.discoveredDuring: Native-playback stored-frame integration review; first registered root and default control only.

evidence.observation: Na/K leader endpoints float above the pore collars. Label coordinates (-3.57,1.52,.3)/(-1.33,1.52,.3) were display offsets; real pore centers are (-3.568,.2,.15)/(-1.332,.2,.15). The rendered Na label ends in background; the K line crosses above the pores.

Ca-channel label endpoint at (-2.08,1.05,.4) is away from pore (-1.6,.55,.25); EAAT target (3.2,-2.04,.3) is below the membrane and transporter, whose drawn uptake ring is at (3.06,-.19,.25). AMPA annotation points below and between receptors instead of either complex.

Both Z-disc leaders end below the actual discs; labels y=-1.55 versus disc extent +/-1.225. Actin and SR leaders also terminate in background, and static Ca-to-troponin text remains present when calcium markers are hidden.

Constrained-sliding target (-3.2,.5,.3) does not follow the bending cilium; the 9+2 and enlarged-section leaders terminate outside the transverse section. At p=0 and ATP absent the motion claim is still active even though geometry is arrested.

issues.whyWrong: ProcessScene and export rendering interpret label.position as the leader target. These legacy text offsets do not identify the named molecular objects; static event labels also imply movement/binding in inactive conditions.
issues.fix: Anchor object-specific labels to existing pores, receptor/EAAT geometry, moving Z discs/actin/ions/nucleotide markers and deforming ciliary geometry; use region anchors for compartment descriptions and hide calcium-transfer/bending-event labels when inactive.
issues.verification: Append geometric world-anchor and active-condition regressions to owned science.test.mjs; preserve roots, labels in both languages, existing scientific geometry and original Phase A findings. Root renders follow-up frames.

issues.kind: state-color visibility in an interior cutaway
issues.discoveredDuring: Review of the seven native default-cell actionPotential frames; confirmed by an actual default-camera ray, then assigned by root.

evidence.observation: Axonal interior lacks a clearly visible repolarization band despite the palette legend.
The colored cylinder cutaway patch is FrontSide, while both axonWall and axoplasm are DoubleSide. From the default camera, its visible interior is a culled back face.

issues.whyWrong: The six existing state bands carry the promised depolarization/repolarization/refractory colors, but their camera-facing inner faces are culled, hiding the spatial signal state. This is a visibility error rather than an alteration to the voltage mechanism.
issues.fix: Make only the existing state-band material DoubleSide, consistent with the axonal inner wall; preserve all geometry, palette, stimulus controls and phase timing.
issues.verification: Use actual default-camera rays on all six band meshes and retain their expected depolarization/repolarization/refractory/rest colors, including no-stimulus control. Root re-renders the state stages.
